title: Lexus to ferry Asean delegates in loaned luxury vehicles

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Luxury hybrid vehicles will be used to transport foreign delegates attending the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits in Metro Manila, with all units to be returned after the country’s hosting period. Lexus Philippines said it would provide a fleet of LS 500h sedans and LM 350h luxury vans for official delegates and representatives of Asean dialogue partners. The company, which serves as an official mobility partner for the Philippines’ Asean 2026 chairship, said its Manila teams would also provide operational support throughout the regional gathering.
